name: PriceWise Calculator Pro
author: Hamza Afridi

sections.description:
PriceWise Calculator Pro FREE allows you to create basic price calculators for your WooCommerce products. Build calculators with number input fields, custom formulas, and automatic assignment to all products.

Free Version Features

  • Number Input Fields – Create calculators with quantity and measurement inputs
  • Global Assignment – Automatically apply calculator to all WooCommerce products
  • Custom Pricing Formulas – Build mathematical calculations with field variables
  • WooCommerce Integration – Seamless integration with WooCommerce cart
  • Live Price Updates – Real-time price calculation as customers input data
  • Responsive Design – Mobile-friendly interface that works on all devices
  • Translation Ready – Full internationalization support with .pot file

Premium Version Features

Upgrade to Premium to unlock:

  • All Field Types – Text, dropdown, radio buttons, checkboxes, sliders, file upload, textarea
  • Product-Specific Assignment – Assign different calculators to individual products
  • Category Assignment – Automatically apply calculators to entire product categories
  • Multi-Step Calculators – Break complex forms into easy step-by-step navigation
  • Advanced Formula Builder – Create complex pricing logic with conditional calculations
  • 15+ Color Customization Controls – Match calculators to your brand
  • Priority Support – Direct email support from our team
  • Regular Updates – Access to new features and improvements

Upgrade to Premium | View Documentation

Perfect For

  • Simple quantity-based pricing
  • Basic measurement calculators
  • Custom product pricing
  • Service quote estimators
  • Getting started with price calculators

How It Works

For Administrators:
1. Create a calculator with name and description
2. Add number input fields with labels and validation rules
3. Configure your pricing formula using field variables
4. Calculator automatically applies to all WooCommerce products

For Customers:
Customers see an intuitive calculator interface on product pages where they input their requirements, see live price updates, and add the customized product to cart.

Documentation & Support

  • Full Documentation: https://devtonicstudios.com/documentation/
  • Website: https://devtonicstudios.com
  • Support: Contact us through our website

Premium Upgrade

Unlock the full power of PriceWise Calculator Pro:

Advanced Field Types
* Text input fields
* Dropdown select fields
* Radio button fields
* Checkbox fields
* Slider fields with visual selection
* File upload fields
* Textarea fields for detailed input

Smart Assignment Options
* Product-Specific: Assign different calculators to individual products
* Category-Based: Automatically apply calculators to entire product categories
* Priority System: Control which calculator displays when multiple are assigned

Enhanced User Experience
* Multi-step slider interface with progress tracking
* Step-by-step guided navigation (NEXT/PREV buttons)
* 15+ color customization controls
* Visual + hex input color picker
* Mobile-optimized touch interactions

Professional Features
* Export/Import calculators for backup and transfer
* Calculation logging and analytics
* Auto-save functionality
* Calculator duplication
* Search and filter calculators
* Bulk actions support

View All Premium Features | Upgrade Now

Developer Notes

Hooks & Filters

The plugin provides hooks and filters for developers:

  • pwcp_before_calculator_render – Runs before calculator is rendered
  • pwcp_after_calculator_render – Runs after calculator is rendered
  • pwcp_calculated_price – Filter the calculated price
  • pwcp_field_value – Filter field values before calculation
  • pwcp_manage_calculators_cap – Change capability required to manage calculators

Template Override

You can override plugin templates by copying them to your theme:
wp-content/themes/your-theme/pricewise-calculator-pro/

Privacy Policy

PriceWise Calculator Pro does not collect or store any personal data from your website visitors. All calculations are performed on your server and no data is sent to external services.

sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or greater
  • PHP version 7.4 or greater
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or greater (for full functionality)
  • MySQL version 5.6 or greater

Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “PriceWise Calculator Pro”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. After installation, click “Activate Plugin”

After Activation

  1. Go to Calculators > Add New
  2. Set calculator name and description
  3. Add number input fields in the Fields tab
  4. Configure your pricing formula in the Formula tab
  5. Set status to “Active” in Settings tab
  6. Your calculator will automatically appear on all WooCommerce products

Critical Setup Requirements

For your calculator to display properly:

  • Your calculator MUST have at least 1 field added – Empty calculators won’t display
  • Your WooCommerce product MUST have a regular price set – Products without prices won’t show calculators
sections.faq:
What features are included in the free version?

The free version includes:
* Number input fields only
* Global assignment only (applies to all products automatically)
* Custom pricing formulas
* WooCommerce integration
* Live price updates
* Mobile responsive design

How do I get additional field types like dropdowns and checkboxes?

Additional field types (text, dropdown, radio, checkbox, slider, file upload, textarea) are available in the Premium version. Learn more

Can I assign calculators to specific products or categories?

Product-specific and category assignment features are available in the Premium version. The free version uses global assignment (one calculator for all products).

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes! The plugin is specifically designed for WooCommerce integration. Both free and premium versions work seamlessly with WooCommerce products and shopping cart.

Is the free version fully functional?

Absolutely! The free version provides everything you need for basic number-based calculators with global assignment. It’s not a trial – you can use it indefinitely.

Can I create multiple calculators in the free version?

You can create multiple calculators, but only one can be active at a time since free version only supports global assignment.

Where can I find documentation?

Complete documentation is available at: https://devtonicstudios.com/documentation/

How do I create a pricing formula?

Use curly braces around your field keys in formulas. For example:
* Formula: (10 + {quantity}) * {measurement}
* This multiplies the sum of base price (10) plus quantity by the measurement value

Why isn’t my calculator showing on the product page?

Check these two critical requirements:
1. Your calculator MUST have at least one field added in the Fields tab
2. Your WooCommerce product MUST have a regular price set

Is translation supported?

Yes! The plugin is fully translation-ready and includes a .pot file for easy translation into any language.
